description: In every PA-model, the specified list-length program adds one on a constructor.
signature:

  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listLength.value
      ![Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listCons.value ![a, c]] =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listLength.value ![c])
